panels.description: Prometheus targets currently reporting for the selected model groups and roles.
panels.title: Model scrape targets

panels.description: Prompt tokens processed per second by the selected model servers.
panels.title: Prompt tokens / s

panels.description: Generated tokens produced per second by the selected model servers.
panels.title: Output tokens / s

panels.description: Requests waiting in the selected model engines, not the shared frontend admission queue.
panels.title: Scheduler queued requests

panels.description: Completed execution requests by backend and finish reason. A backend is one model instance and data-parallel rank; multi-stage requests can complete once in each role.
panels.title: Completed request rate

panels.description: Prompt and generated tokens per second by backend. A backend is one model instance and data-parallel rank.
panels.title: Token throughput

panels.description: Requests running in vLLM execution batches or waiting in its scheduler.
panels.title: Scheduler state

panels.description: Request-weighted latency from frontend processing to generation completion across the selected engines. Excludes downstream client delivery; clocks must be synchronized.
panels.title: End-to-end latency (E2EL)

panels.description: Request-weighted time from frontend processing to the first token at model-server across the selected engines. Excludes downstream client delivery.
panels.title: Time to first token (TTFT)

panels.description: Request-weighted TPOT across selected engines, in milliseconds. Each request contributes its average output-token interval.
panels.title: Time per output token (TPOT)

panels.description: Output-token interval distribution across selected engines, in milliseconds. Each token interval is one observation.
panels.title: Inter-token latency (ITL)

panels.description: P95 time, in seconds, a request spends waiting for the scheduler, in prefill, and in decode.
panels.title: Request time by stage

panels.description: Scheduler preemptions per second by backend; sustained activity indicates KV-cache pressure.
panels.title: Preemptions

panels.description: Distribution of prompt tokens per request over time.
panels.title: Prompt length

panels.description: Distribution of generated tokens per request over time.
panels.title: Output length

panels.description: KV-cache occupancy by model instance and engine rank.
panels.title: KV Cache utilization

panels.description: Cache hits divided by queried tokens across selected engines. Idle or unavailable caches have no ratio; local and external observations are separate.
panels.title: Prefix Cache hit ratio

panels.description: Mounted RuntimeCache filesystem utilization. Series are absent for model groups without a RuntimeCache.
panels.title: Storage usage

panels.description: Filesystem space available to model-server processes using a RuntimeCache.
panels.title: Available storage

panels.description: Utilization of each Foretoken-attributed GPU.

panels.description: Latest published recommendation, adjusted target and applied desired capacity. A missing recommendation means the decision algorithm did not provide one.
